objective: Ablate RoPE vs NoPE and Query-Mirror vs residual-boundary Mirror in a shared two-pass causal Transformer; test if NoPE specifically improves Mirror's incremental benefit rather than generally changing task difficulty
notes: Earlier MA1178-1180 MLP distillation never used RoPE; their negative results cannot be attributed to RoPE. This is new causal attention experiment, not a reanalysis.

tasks.set_membership: 9 random content tokens; label 1 iff token3 occurs anywhere; balanced by construction; 10th token is fixed query token; order independent
tasks.last_slot: Exactly one token3 among first 9; label 1 iff at last content slot (index8); balanced positives and negatives; 10th token is fixed query; order sensitive

models.insertion: Q-only Householder applied per recurrent pass (mirror_q); residual-stream Householder applied at each shared block boundary with inverse after block (mirror_residual); two codes for recurrent passes; film_q has two same-length per-pass conditional vectors
models.shared: unmodified same-base recurrent Transformer; no per-loop codes
models.architecture: 1 token embedding, 1 shared transformer block repeated twice, d_model16, 1 attention head, FFN width32, SiLU, causal mask, last-token binary readout. No explicit position signal in NoPE; RoPE applied to query/key in head-dim 2D bands.
models.init: same RNG seed for common backbone among all four arms at a given seed, task, position; Householder codes randomly initialized but orthonormalized in forward, optional film codes initial near identity

metrics: NoPE versus RoPE interaction relative to FiLM

gates.primary_screening: In set_membership, NoPE yields an improvement in the Mirror-Q-vs-FiLM Fresh CE gap >= 0.02 nats over RoPE in >=2 of 3 paired seeds; define gap = CE(film_q)-CE(mirror_q). This is screening only.
gates.mirror_nope_useful: Mirror-Q beats FiLM-Q by >=0.02 CE in >=2/3 NoPE set_membership seeds; screening only.
gates.sanity: training and evaluation causal; all checkpoints hashes sealed before Fresh; NoPE paired same-rotation Q/K logits invariant; RoPE paired mirror can change logits when noncommuting; no claims about natural language or speed without bytes/runtime measures

hardware_contract: CPU FP32 torch 1 thread, 2026-10-30 runtime record, clock not fixed; training steps match, FLOPs not precisely matched
limitations: Three independent seeds and synthetic tasks, 350 updates. Findings strictly exploratory. If results differ between tasks interpret as positional-inductive-bias tradeoff. Query-only Mirror is not by itself non-absorptive across passes, only different per-loop codes can provide extra function switches.
